53 Attachment of earnings.

(1) In section 3 of the M38Attachment of Earnings Act 1971 (court’s power to make order)
the following subsections shall be inserted after subsection (3A)—
“(3B) Where—
(a) a magistrates’ court imposes a fine on a person in respect of an
offence, and
(b) that person consents to an order being made under this subsection,
the court may at the time it imposes the fine, and without the need for an
application, make an attachment of earnings order to secure the payment of
the fine.
(3C) Where—
(a) a magistrates’ court makes in the case of a person convicted of an
offence an order under section 35 of the M39Powers of Criminal Courts
Act 1973 (a compensation order) requiring him to pay compensation
or to make other payments, and
(b) that person consents to an order being made under this subsection,
the court may at the time it makes the compensation order, and without the
need for an application, make an attachment of earnings order to secure the
payment of the compensation or other payments.”
